title: Fix "Open a new project..." doing nothing in the Ctrl+S picker
notes: Hit Ctrl+S, click "Open a new project...", and the folder dialog opens. Confirmed by hand on 2026-09-07 in a build carrying PR #14. There was never a second cause: the quit question was asked with showMessageBoxSync, which stopped the whole main process, so a folder panel already open could never finish. PR #14 asks it with the async showMessageBox and the panel comes back. No code of its own.
